description: What Dolphin's and PrimeHack's own loaders take (#618): whole fixture machines in, the launchability verdict of each Dolphin and PrimeHack entry out — judged by the loader cards read at the builds RetroDECK ships, for the command shapes those cards were read for.

vectors.name: dolphin-a-zip-on-wii-is-not-accepted-by-the-dolphin-entry
vectors.rationale: RetroDECK's wii list declares .zip on account of every entry, and the entry the frontend puts first is Dolphin's own: its loader takes a file by extension and holds no branch for an archive, so the zip is refused and the verdict is entry-not-accepted. PrimeHack refuses it the same way and the libretro entry's core was not read, so no entry is established to take it.

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<systemList>
  <system>
    <name>wii</name>
    <path>%ROMPATH%/wii</path>
    <extension>.ciso .CISO .dff .DFF .dol .DOL .elf .ELF .gcm .GCM .gcz .GCZ .iso .ISO .json .JSON .m3u .M3U .rvz .RVZ .tgc .TGC .wad .WAD .wbfs .WBFS .wia .WIA .7z .7Z .zip .ZIP</extension>
    <command label="Dolphin (Standalone)">env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb %EMULATOR_DOLPHIN% -b -e %ROM%</command>
    <command label="Dolphin">%EMULATOR_RETROARCH% -L %CORE_RETROARCH%/dolphin_libretro.so %ROM%</command>
    <command label="PrimeHack (Standalone)">env QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb %EMULATOR_PRIMEHACK% -b -e %ROM%</command>
  </system>
</systemList>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ruleList>
    <emulator name="DOLPHIN">
        <rule type="staticpath">
            <entry>/app/retrodeck/components/dolphin/component_launcher.sh</entry>
        </rule>
    </emulator>
    <emulator name="PRIMEHACK">
        <rule type="staticpath">
            <entry>/app/retrodeck/components/primehack/component_launcher.sh</entry>
        </rule>
    </emulator>
    <emulator name="RETROARCH">
        <rule type="staticpath">
            <entry>/app/retrodeck/components/retroarch/component_launcher.sh</entry>
        </rule>
    </emulator>
    <core name="RETROARCH">
        <rule type="corepath">
            <entry>/var/config/retroarch/cores</entry>
        </rule>
    </core>
</ruleList>

vectors.name: dolphin-an-rvz-is-launchable-with-its-content-unread
vectors.rationale: An .rvz is in the disc set Dolphin's loader takes; the loader then reads the disc's magic, which atlas does not, so the verdict is launchable with entry-format-content-unread stating it.

vectors.rationale: ES-DE's scan is case-exact and the list carries .ISO, so the file is scanned; Dolphin's loader folds the extension's case before it compares, so the card takes .ISO as .iso.

vectors.name: primehack-a-bin-depends-on-the-build
vectors.rationale: PrimeHack's disc set carries .bin at the build EmuDeck installs and not at the build RetroDECK ships, and the card serves both: neither a take nor a refusal holds everywhere, so the entry's reading is unestablished and the verdict stays on the accept-list with entry-format-build-dependent.

vectors.name: dolphin-a-command-of-another-shape-stays-unestablished
vectors.rationale: The card was read for a command handing Dolphin -b -e %ROM%; an entry handing it the file without -e is one the card does not answer for, so it stays entry-format-unestablished — and the .zip it would refuse is not refused.

vectors.name: emudeck-dolphin-with-the-upstream-prefix-refuses-a-zip
vectors.rationale: EmuDeck's ES-DE runs its own catalogue, whose Dolphin entry opens with an %INJECT% of a per-game prefix file: that text is placed in front of the emulator, and Dolphin is still handed -b -e %ROM%, so the card answers — the zip is refused.

vectors.name: emudeck-dolphin-on-consolearcade-takes-an-iso-with-its-content-unread
vectors.rationale: ES-DE's consolearcade system declares a Dolphin entry of the same shape; named by its label, it takes an .iso by its extension, with the content unread.

/home/deck/Applications/ES-DE.AppImage.usr/share/es-de/resources/systems/linux/:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<systemList>
  <system>
    <name>consolearcade</name>
    <path>%ROMPATH%/consolearcade</path>
    <extension>.arcadedef .desktop .iso .ISO .ps3 .PS3 .sh .xbe .XBE .7z .7Z .zip .ZIP</extension>
    <command label="MAME - Current">%EMULATOR_RETROARCH% -L %CORE_RETROARCH%/mame_libretro.so %ROM%</command>
    <command label="Dolphin">%EMULATOR_RETROARCH% -L %CORE_RETROARCH%/dolphin_libretro.so %ROM%</command>
    <command label="Dolphin (Standalone)">%INJECT%=%BASENAME%.esprefix %EMULATOR_DOLPHIN% -b -e %ROM%</command>
    <command label="Triforce (Standalone)">%INJECT%=%BASENAME%.esprefix %EMULATOR_TRIFORCE% -b -e %ROM%</command>
  </system>
</systemList>
